title: Amis
description: Groomed for leadership at the Royal Academy of Government on Mandalore, Amis was one of the brightest students of the next generation of Mandalorians. Alongside his friends—Korkie Kryze and others—he helped investigate the corruption on Mandalore. Breaking into a secret warehouse, they discovered evidence of a harmful black market operating right under the noses of Mandalorian officials. Worse, it was run by Prime Minister Almec himself who turned out to be greedy and corrupt!
